semiconductor_relevance: High — Suruga Seiki provides high-precision optical measurement equipment essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Suruga Seiki specializes in optical sensor products that enable high-precision measurement and alignment in semiconductor manufacturing. Their offerings include the SmartLAC H410 laser autocollimator, which is designed for precise tilt angle measurement of wafers and substrates, enhancing the accuracy of semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: SmartLAC H410 laser autocollimator for tilt angle measurement
3-axis sensor for simultaneous measurement of displacement and tilt angle
